name: AdmiralBet.news
note: Sports news blog; the club's 2024 announcement of the partnership quotes Paolo Marchi, Managing Director of Admiral Sport S.r.l., announcing it. A gambling-linked media brand of the kind Italian clubs use since the gambling-advertising ban (compare Eurobet.live, kaiyunsports.news records). Ultimate ownership not traced with a claim. Second (front) sponsor of Parma Calcio since 2024/25.
